description: >
  A two-year Consolidación Investigadora project from the Ministerio de Ciencia

---

Ferran Feixas has been awarded a **Consolidación Investigadora** project by the
Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación, for *Hacia la reconstrucción computacional de
la evolución en tiempo real de procesos biomoleculares y supramoleculares* —
towards the computational reconstruction of the real-time evolution of
biomolecular and supramolecular processes.

The project runs from April 2026 to March 2028, with funding of €192,390
(reference CNS2025-165326). It continues the group's work on reconstructing how
biomolecular processes evolve in time, and how their environment reshapes them.

Full details are on the [projects](../projects.qmd) page.
